title: Pair rule is invariant under reordering
statement: Let $i,j,k$ be pairwise distinct elements of $\{0,1,2\}$, and assign a sign $v(r)\in\{-1,1\}$ to each index $r$. The rule that returns $v(i)$ if $v(i)=v(j)$ and returns $v(k)$ otherwise equals the majority of the three assigned signs.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ assigns a sign to each element of $\{0,1,2\}$
